correctness.rationale: For volume-uniform B_3, strict exclusion y outside z+tB gives limiting minimal center distance D=t-r. Intersection volume of radii 1 and t decreases with separation. Splitting circular slices at x0=(t^2-1-D^2)/(2D), integrating and dividing by 4π/3 yields L. Direct exact-rational algebra gives 1-L-(2-3r+r^3)/4=3(1-r²)^2/[16(t-r)]. The derivative has sign of 3r²-4tr+1, giving a single interior radial maximizer r_t=1/(2t+sqrt(4t²-3)); at t=1 its error is 2/9, and the full uniform asymptotic begins 3/(16t)+3/(128t³). At r>=1, both depth functions vanish, and the removable t=r=1 endpoint is zero. This reconstructs all t>=1 and all ambient y; finite rational sampling does not establish it alone.
